notes: Converts Microsoft dotnet-install.sh at a fixed commit; current official dot.net/v1 entrypoint had identical bytes. Pins active LTS .NET 10 SDK 10.0.403 with runtime 10.0.14.

Preserves official argument parsing, OS/architecture/product-version selection, archive extraction, version-directory install behavior, size comparison, and already-installed handling. Only downloader prerequisite, network transport, product-version fetch transport, and HTTP size lookup are adapted.

SDK archive matches Microsoft official release-metadata SHA-512; the offline download adapter verifies that SHA-512 again before the original installer extracts it. Every source and resource also has a SHA-256 pin.

Includes the complete SDK, C# compiler, .NET/ASP.NET runtimes, reference packs and templates from the official SDK archive. Does not include optional workloads, cross-target runtime packs or external NuGet packages.

Ubuntu 22.04 runtime library prerequisites: libc6, libgcc-s1, libgssapi-krb5-2, libicu70, libssl3, libstdc++6, zlib1g (plus ca-certificates for future HTTPS use). These are explicitly prepared in the recorded test image and are not bundled system-library installers.

The offline C# test creates a fresh console project, clears all NuGet feeds, restores only SDK-provided framework references, builds and runs it, and asserts LINQ, JSON serialization and real French ICU culture data. Telemetry, workload update notifications and development-certificate generation are disabled.
Installs directly under the requested prefix. Run <prefix>/dotnet or add that prefix to PATH; the official --no-path option is preserved. No host installation or shell profile editing is performed.
